stem:
Farid lists three cell jobs: letting useful materials in and wastes out while separating cells; housing many life processes; and regulating the cell’s activities and growth.

Which main cell part does the first job?

options.text: The cytoplasm, because many life processes occur there.
The cell membrane, because it controls what enters and leaves and separates cells.
The nucleus, because it regulates the cell’s activities and growth.
The cell membrane, because controlling materials in and out also means it regulates the cell’s growth.

teacher.key_rationale: Boundary exchange and separation are membrane jobs. Cytoplasm is where many processes occur; the nucleus regulates activities and growth; saying the membrane also regulates growth conflates exchange with nuclear control.
